subject.title: feat: announce critical session health beyond the rail and teach companion delegation

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally notify every authorized Control UI session subscriber when any background session newly becomes stuck or waits for user input, and include companion-use guidance in the webchat system prompt?
rationale: The patch is an intentional user-facing delivery and prompting policy change, not a narrowly pre-existing bug contract; the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human ownership of that behavior.

options.title: Approve the scoped notification policy
options.body: Accept critical-transition-only delivery to operator-read subscribers and the transient notice approach, contingent on accessible after-fix proof and normal merge checks.

options.title: Keep health scoped to visible sessions
options.body: Retain the existing rail-only delivery model and decline the broader notification behavior if cross-session alerts are not desired.

options.title: Narrow the prompt guidance
options.body: Accept the notice behavior but revise or omit the system-prompt instruction if agent delegation policy needs separate product discussion.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped notification policy
recommendation.body: Accept critical-transition-only delivery to operator-read subscribers and the transient notice approach, contingent on accessible after-fix proof and normal merge checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposal’s current feature history and rationale are concentrated in this contributor’s focused commits, though stronger current-main ownership evidence was unavailable.
